resources.string: Community artwork for completing app icons. Sync a snapshot explicitly, then choose a style and generate locally.

Perfect Icons collects community-contributed artwork. Download the styles you need from Resources; later updates reuse unchanged files. Downloaded resources support offline previews, native ZIP generation and supported icon fallback. Opening this page reads local data and does not start a download.
Historical packaging reference. KeiHome generates its own native ZIPs; this link is provided for attribution.
